description_text: Info: Als AI-Engineer - Dealflow entwickelst und verantwortest du das Produkt bzw. Du evaluierst neue Prospecting- und Sourcing-Tools und entwickelst Ansprache, Sequenzen und unsere Messaging-Bibliothek weiter. Dein Profil Du hast eigene Tools und Automatisierungen gebaut, die produktiv im Einsatz waren, nicht nur Prototypen und Demos. Du bringst mindestens 2–3 Jahre Erfahrung im Aufbau AI-basierter Produkte/Tools mit. Du entwickelst selbstständig in Python und deployst mit Docker auf Azure in Produktion. Du kennst LLM-APIs (OpenAI, Claude) aus der Praxis und weißt, wo sie zuverlässig funktionieren und wo (noch) nicht. Du hast bereits Erfahrung im Umgang mit CRM-Daten und weißt, worauf es bei Datenqualität und -struktur ankommt. Kenntnisse in Pipedrive, Agentensystemen sowie Frameworks wie LangGraph sind ein Plus. Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch und Englisch. Benefits Raum zum Wachsen und die Möglichkeit, viel Verantwortung zu übernehmen, kombiniert mit halbjährlichem Feedback und einem individuellen Weiterbildungsbudget. Persönliche und berufliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch ein inspirierendes und dynamisches Umfeld und flache Hierarchien. Regelmäßige Events, ein gemeinsamer Sommerurlaub sowie verschiedene Gesundheitsangebote wie beispielsweise zweimonatliche Massage / Physiotherapie im Büro. Moderne und ergonomische Arbeitsmittel, ein Office im Herzen Berlins direkt am Park am Gleisdreieck sowie eine voll ausgestattete Küche mit gesunden Snacks, Softdrinks und einem monatlichen Friday Beer/Sekt/Wein. Ein attraktives Gehaltspaket inklusive Möglichkeiten zur Brutto-Netto-Optimierung. Über uns FLEX Capital ist ein Private Equity Fonds, der sich auf Wachstums- und Buy-out-Möglichkeiten im deutschen Software- und Tech-Mittelstand fokussiert. Hinter FLEX Capital stehen sechs Seriengründer, die mehrfach marktführende Unternehmen mit internationaler Geschäftstätigkeit aufgebaut haben. Auf dieser Basis teilt das FLEX-Team seine Erfahrungen mit Unternehmern und Management Teams, unterstützt sie Hands-on und hilft ihnen so, die gemeinsamen Ziele zu erreichen. Kontakt Join us! 80 Beats Medical is a Berlin-based medical technology company developing innovative solutions for cardiovascular and vascular diagnostics. Our VICORDER® platform enables non-invasive assessment of vascular health Building on this established technology, we are expanding our clinical diagnostic portfolio by combining medical device technology with advanced data analytics and AI. Our goal is to transform complex physiological and cardiovascular data into reliable, clinically meaningful insights that can support earlier risk detection and better-informed clinical decisions. We are a growing, international team working at the intersection of medical devices, software, data science, and clinical research. We are looking for an experienced Data Scientist / Data Engineer to help build the data and AI infrastructure behind our next generation of medical diagnostic solutions. You will work with high-frequency physiological and clinical data, developing secure and scalable data pipelines and supporting the transition of machine learning models from research into production-ready clinical applications. You will work closely with our software, clinical, and regulatory teams in a highly interdisciplinary environment. Tasks Design, build, and maintain robust, scalable, and secure data ingestion and transformation pipelines. Implement automated ingestion, validation, lineage tracking, and quality monitoring. Develop and maintain reusable data libraries, transformation logic, and governance frameworks. Ensure full compliance with GDPR, NIS2, Cyber Resilience Act (EU), HIPAA (US) and other global regulatory frameworks. Experience with implementation of Role-based access control (RBAC), Encryption in transit and at rest (HSM/KMS), Data anonymization & pseudonymization workflows and Consent handling and audit mechanisms. Participate in security audits, compliance reviews, and certification efforts. Operationalize AI pipelines including model deployment, monitoring, drift handling, versioning, and automated retraining. Deploy explainable AI tooling (SHAP/LIME) into the pipeline for auditability and compliance. Maintain CI/CD workflows for data and ML workloads. Develop Python-based analytics scripts, reusable data modules, and feature engineering logic. Support visualization of workflows. Ensure reproducibility and model traceability across the full lifecycle. Requirements QUALIFICATIONS Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data science, AI, Cybersecurity, or similar. 5+ years of experience building secure, compliant cloud-based data ecosystems ( for regulated data domains. Hands-on experience with time-series data, sensor data, or biomedical/wearable data. Knowledge of statistical programming Strong understanding of ML approaches for classification, anomaly detection, and prediction using high-frequency data. Proficiency in one or more programming languages Advanced experience with Orchestration, Data frameworks, and Infrastructure automation. Proven cross-functional communication skills. Clear, documentation-driven engineering approach. GOOD TO HAVE Experience with multilevel longitudinal data, missing data strategies, and clinical outcome modeling. Good working knowledge of either AWS, Azure, or GCP Hands on experience with Python and/or JavaScript including libraries for ML such as TensorFlow and PyTorch and visualization libraries such as Tableau, Looker, Grafana, or Streamlit Previous work with Airflow, Dagster for Orchestration and Prefect, Spark, dbt, Kafka for data frameworks and Terraform, Kubernetes, Helm for infrastructure automation. Knowledge of medical data formats (FHIR, HL7, DICOM). Management of encryption standards and secure authentication Benefits Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package. Opportunities for professional growth and development. A supportive and innovative work environment. The chance to make a meaningful impact on the lives of patients and healthcare professionals. You are at the forefront of developing technology that saves lives – what else is there? Join our innovative Berlin team as a Data Scientist / Data Engineer to revolutionize cardiovascular diagnostics through cutting-edge technology and international collaboration. About the role We're looking for a Data Scientist to take ownership of the datasets and evaluation workflows that underpin our AI Safety work. Experience managing human-in-the-loop labelling processes, dataset versioning, or ML pipeline tooling. Experience operationalising guidelines with policy or legal teams. Location This role is based in London, where you'll work closely with our AI Safety and Policy teams. description_text: About the team SumUp is best known for helping small businesses get paid — our Consumer tribe builds the other half of that story. We make SumUp Consumer, the wallet app that lets everyday consumers pay SumUp merchants with a tap, send money to friends, track their spending and earn loyalty rewards along the way. As we grow SumUp Consumer across new markets and features, we need sharp, reliable insight into how people discover, adopt and use the product — and how that behaviour translates into sustainable commercial growth. This includes understanding our acquisition funnel, improving activation and conversion, increasing customer value, and reducing churn. We're looking for a Product Data Analyst to join the Consumer tribe and become the analytical partner for SumUp Consumer. You'll work closely with Product Managers, Designers and Engineers, alongside our Analytics Engineering team, to understand customer behaviour, shape product strategy, and connect product performance to business outcomes. You'll help answer questions such as: Which acquisition channels and customer segments generate the strongest long-term value? description_text: About us UVC Partners is one of Europe’s leading early-stage venture capital firms. With our fourth fund generation of €250 million, we invest in disruptive B2B startups at the seed and Series A stage across Europe. Our focus areas include enterprise software, mobility, and industrial technologies. Headquartered in Munich and closely integrated with UnternehmerTUM, Europe’s largest entrepreneurship center, we are proud partners to some of Europe’s most ambitious founders – including Flixbus, Isar Aerospace, finn.auto, Proxima Fusion, and Aleph Alpha. At UVC Partners, we’re driven by a deep passion for entrepreneurship and its power to positively shape society. Environmental and social responsibility are core to our DNA. We hold ourselves to the highest standards in everything we do. As a firm, we continuously reinvent ourselves to stay ahead and best serve our portfolio and investors. We believe in ownership over hierarchy and foster a culture built on collaboration, curiosity, and personal engagement. And while we’re serious about our mission, we also genuinely enjoy working together and building lasting relationships along the way. Your mission You will join a specialized team working at the intersection of applied research and venture capital, side by side with investors, AI researchers, and engineers building the backbone of our investment intelligence. This is a hands-on role with real stakes. You will be treated as a full member of the team, expected to take a research question from literature to a working prototype and to present your results to the people who make the investment decisions. Your profile You are enrolled in a Master’s program in Computer Science, Data Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a similar program at a top university. You bring depth, or the ambition to build it, in at least one relevant toolkit, whether that is graph ML and graph databases (e.g. PyTorch Geometric), LLM tooling, tool use and evaluation, or probabilistic modeling (e.g. PyMC, NumPyro). You write clean, modular Python and have firm machine learning and statistics fundamentals. You are fluent with AI-assisted coding tools and you have judgment about them. You know what they do well, where they quietly fail, and you review everything they produce. You do not ship AI slop. You work independently. You have run a project where you set the direction yourself, and you can point to it. You are fluent in English, including technical language. It is what you will work, write, and present in. German is helpful but not required. How we work We are an AI-powered development team . Everyone here codes with AI assistance, and we treat that as a craft. You need to know which parts of a problem to hand over, where these tools fail quietly, and how to review output you did not write. Agency matters a lot in our team. You get mentorship, context, and access to everyone. You do not get someone assigning you tasks every morning. Take a rough problem statement, come back with an approach, show drafts while they can still change, and flag what is not working. What you bring should outweigh what it costs us to support you. Potential Research Directions These are directions we could explore, with scope defined together at the start based on your background and where the work leads. 1. With Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) we would work on a graph-structured database, where people and companies are nodes and the relationships between them are part of the data, and ask what that structure can tell us that a table cannot. 2. With Program-aided Language Models (PAL) we would have the model write a small program for every number it pulls from decks and financial statements, so figures are accurately computed, because that is what makes it safe to point a language model at financial data. 3. And with Bayesian Updating we would keep our recorded understanding of a company moving as new evidence arrives, since the investment process is iterative and a view written down two years ago should not still be the view today. Your thesis could focus on one of these, though as a full-time member of the team you will work across several. Academic Supervision: The Lead of the Data & AI Team is a PhD candidate at TUM's School of Computation, Information and Technology (CIT) and can supervise CIT masters students directly, so there is no separate supervisor search. However, you are free to choose your own supervisor and candidates from other universities bring their own. What we offer Network: A desk at the Munich Urban Colab, our main office, with the option of a second one in Garching, plus access to the UnternehmerTUM ecosystem of startups, experts, and investors. Team & Culture: Monthly team lunches, our regular Stammtisch, free sports classes, Makerspace access for your personal projects, and regular team events. Compensation: An attractive salary for the full six months of your master thesis or internship. Ownership: Research that is yours end to end and feeds real fund decisions. Equipment: A MacBook or a Windows laptop, whichever you work best on. AI Tooling: Full access to the AI development stack we use daily, and a team that will teach you to use it properly. Real Data: Proprietary venture data that researchers rarely get access to, with the pipelines to use it productively. Interested? Please send a one-page CV, a current transcript, and a link to your GitHub or portfolio. Tell us which of these directions interests you most and why. We look forward to hearing from you! Diversity is important to us Diversity enriches our team. We explicitly encourage all qualified individuals to apply, regardless of gender, social and ethnic background, sexual orientation, religion, age, or disability. Contact Unternehmertum Venture Capital Partners GmbH , c/o Munich Urban Colab, Freddie- Mercury-Straße 5, 80797 Munich, Germany www.uvcpartners.com UVC Partners is an equal opportunity employer. UVC Partners is an independent venture capital fund. For efficiency, we use certain shared services from UnternehmerTUM. This is why parts of the application process may appear UTUM-branded, and your application will be processed by UVC Partners and UnternehmerTUM. Life at UiPath The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power. To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose. Could that be you? Your mission This is one of the most exciting problems in applied AI right now: take the cutting edge of machine learning, optimisation, and agentic systems, and make it work inside real businesses — not in a lab, but on live customer problems where the answer has to hold up commercially. As a Forward Deployed Scientist II, in our Supply Chain & Retail business, you’ll work directly with some of the world’s biggest retailers and manufacturers on hard, high-stakes problems: demand forecasting, price and promotion optimisation, and supply-chain decisioning. You’ll own the science end-to-end — from understanding a customer’s messy reality to shipping something that changes how they operate. And you won’t just deliver. What you learn on the front line feeds directly back into the products we build, so you’re shaping the capability the whole business runs on — not just solving one problem at a time. What you'll do at UiPath Own customer engagements end-to-end — frame the problem, build the solution, and drive it to real commercial impact, working directly alongside customer teams. Apply and adapt frontier ML, forecasting, and optimisation techniques — and increasingly agentic AI — to problems that don’t have a textbook answer. Turn what works on the ground into product direction, so each engagement makes our core capability better for the next customer. Operate with genuine autonomy across a wide range of stakeholders — from data scientists to customer executives — and make the judgment calls that get things shipped. Stay at the edge of what’s possible in applied AI, and bring it back to the team. What you'll bring to the team Strong track record applying ML / data science to real-world commercial problems, ideally with depth in forecasting, optimisation, or supply-chain / pricing. The instinct to own outcomes, not tasks — you take an ambiguous problem and drive it to a result rather than waiting to be told the next step. Fluent programming (Python and SQL) and the ability to pick up whatever a problem demands. Excellent communication — you can take a customer executive from confusion to confidence, and explain a complex model to a non-technical room. Comfort with ambiguity, direct customer contact, and the pace of a team that ships. Bonus: experience with agentic / LLM-based systems, or building ML in production. Who thrives here We’re looking for builders — smart, switched-on people who want to be handed a genuinely hard real-world challenge and go to town on it. If you want to work at the frontier of applied AI, own something that matters, and see your work land with real customers and shape a product, this is for you. job_title: Working Student (all genders) – Robust Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction for Dynamic Scene
description_text: Abstract Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models can recover scene geometry directly from images or videos without costly scene-specific optimization. By combining large-scale pre-training, multi-view reasoning, and strong geometric priors, these models provide an efficient alternative to traditional reconstruction pipelines such as Structure-from-Motion, NeRF, and optimization-based 3D Gaussian Splatting. Despite recent progress, current models remain sensitive to challenging real-world conditions. Occlusions, moving objects, illumination changes, nighttime scenes, reflections, rain, fog, and snow can result in incomplete geometry, unreliable correspondences, and temporally inconsistent predictions. Improving robustness under such conditions is essential for autonomous driving and robotic perception. As a working student, you will support the development of robust feed-forward reconstruction models for dynamic scenes. You will investigate methods for handling occlusion, changing illumination, and adverse weather, and explore how large reconstruction models can serve as general-purpose geometric backbones for downstream 3D scene understanding, particularly semantic occupancy prediction and 4D occupancy forecasting. These tasks interest you Develop and evaluate feed-forward 3D reconstruction models for dynamic scenes using monocular or multi-view image sequences. Investigate reconstruction robustness under partial and long-term occlusions, moving objects, and incomplete observations. Develop methods to improve geometric consistency under illumination changes, low-light conditions, shadows, and reflections. Evaluate and improve model performance under adverse weather conditions such as rain, fog, snow, and reduced visibility. Compare the developed methods with relevant baselines and document technical and experimental results. That makes you stand out You are currently pursuing a degree in computer science, artificial intelligence, robotics, electrical engineering, data science, or a related field. You have excellent programming skills in Python as well as hands-on experience with PyTorch . You have a good understanding of computer vision, deep learning, 3D geometry , or multi-view vision . Experience with depth estimation, optical flow, point clouds, camera pose estimation, NeRF, 3D Gaussian Splatting, or 3D reconstruction is highly beneficial. Your language skills enable you to perform your role in English (at least C1 level) . Knowledge of German is desirable but not required.
